description: This walk or cycle takes you along the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal Towpath from Rileys Lock to Swains Lock near Poolesville, Maryland. You'll also visit Great Falls where you can see a series of rapids and waterfalls on the Potomac River. Along the way you can look out for a variety of wildlife including herons and kingfishers along the canal banks and you may even glimpse deer in the underbrush. For more routes along the canal see the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal Towpath Georgetown page.
